reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Generic overdispersed count model with Normal shrinkage; simulations and alternative spike-in/same-sample RNA assay/new-cohort validation.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult and verify primary Methods, supplements or validated tool protocols and transfer their settings to the selected dataset. Documenting settings or calling a method standard is not that action.

checks.quote: Any instantiated overdispersed count model must be recorded and justified.
checks.reason: The likelihood, normalization, robust prior-width estimation and numerical solver/calibration procedure remain unspecified despite the requested proposed complete method.
Biological replication is recognized, but a justified meaningful-effect/precision or power calculation and simulation Monte Carlo precision/stopping rule are absent.
No operational randomized/balanced processing or masked QC/estimator-comparison plan, nor justified equivalent bias control, is specified.

checks.quote: Exclusion of samples after inspection must be documented
checks.reason: Documentation alone does not make post-inspection exclusions prospective and outcome independent. No full failed-fit/missing-data denominator or stopping rule is given.
No executable primary method-difference uncertainty procedure and relevant multiplicity/error-control rule is fixed; listing metrics or interval outputs is insufficient.
Sensitivity scenarios are named, but bounded settings or a concrete derivation-and-lock procedure for the essential prior/filter/model choices are absent.
Possible failure modes are named without a diagnostic result linked to an ordered technical repair and retest.
No operational iteration policy identifies what stays frozen, what may change and the fresh independent confirmation required after a change.

checks.quote: Validation option C: independent replicate cohort
checks.reason: The frozen criterion permits independent OR orthogonal validation. The answer provides both same-RNA orthogonal measurements and a separate biological-cohort option, with measurement uncertainty limitations. Same-sample assays are not new biological replication, but that distinction alone is not a P14 failure. This corrects an overstrict initial second-round interpretation; no candidate or v1 content changed.
A useful checksum/command manifest is supplied, but the executable environment/code and immutable source-table-to-figure output mapping are not specified.
There is no explicit separation of prior/normalization/simulation tuning from independent validation and no rule keeping all fitted transformations inside resampling folds.
Perfect confounding is excluded, but missingness and composition/outlier stress are not operationalized; simply recording a batch model does not provide those tests.
Figure concepts do not supply numeric source tables plus a clean-environment rerun, numerical tolerances, resource/failure logs and source-difference audit.
